title: Kab aaoge bhaiya
body:
ye bemaar sughra ne akbar ko likha
kab aaoge bhaiya kab aaoge bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot bad gaya mere jeene ka khatra
kab aaoge bhaiya kab aaoge bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi baat rehti hai aksar zaban par
mujhe bhool baithe ho tum door jaa kar
akele madine may darti hoo bhaiya
kab aaoge bhaiya kab aaoge bhaiya
ye bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabhi ne mujhe besahara kiya hai
bahot jald sab ne kanara kiya hai
ye aun o mohamed se qasim se kehna
kab aaoge bhaiya kab aaoge bhaiya
ye bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi khair hai mujhko le jao aa kar
udaasi ke seene pa rakhe hai pathar
kahin toot jaye na saanson ka rishta
kab aaoge bhaiya kab aaoge bhaiya
ye bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzarta hai din bekasi ke sahare
nikalte hai aankhon se ashkon ke dhaare
idhar shaam aayi udhar dard utha
kab aaoge bhaiya kab aaoge bhaiya
ye bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
bigadti chali jaa rahi hai tabiyat
hai ghere huwe har taraf se musibat
badalne ko rukh hai meri zindagi ka
kab aaoge bhaiya kab aaoge bhaiya
ye bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai dehleez par aa ke baithi rahungi
tum awaaz doge to mai bol dungi
agar bhejna khat to itna batana
kab aaoge bhaiya kab aaoge bhaiya
ye bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ruke hi nahi ashk aankhon may ishrat
hui soghwaron may barpa qayamat
padha jis ne nauha suna jis ne nauha
kab aaoge bhaiya kab aaoge bhaiya
ye bemaar sughra...
author: Ishrat Lakhnavi
